TAKE ACTION FOR GAZA: PALESTINE IS EVERYWHERE

As Israel, the US, and complicit Arab regimes continue to starve and slaughter the people of Gaza, we must continue to find creative ways to uplift Palestine and take action against the ongoing genocide. Do not wait for a protest, take creative action every day on your own or with your crew to put Palestine everywhere in New York City. Swipe through these slides to learn about different autonomous actions that you can take today 🇵🇸
